plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Metaswitch MetaView EMS / softswitch nodes (METASWITCH-MIB, arc 1.2.826.0.1.1578918.6). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports per-node total CPU usage and its high-water mark and physical memory total, used and usage percent for the current 5-minute period.
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: metaswitch_ems_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Total CPU usage of a MetaView EMS node for the current 5-minute summary period (METASWITCH-MIB emsStatsTotCPUUsage, Unsigned32 0-100).

metrics.name: metaswitch_ems_cpu_usage_hwm
metrics.description: High-water mark of total CPU usage of a MetaView EMS node (METASWITCH-MIB emsStatsTotCPUUsageHighWaterMark, Unsigned32 0-100).

metrics.name: metaswitch_ems_mem_total_mb
metrics.description: Total physical memory of a MetaView EMS node in megabytes (METASWITCH-MIB emsStatsTotPhysMem).

metrics.name: metaswitch_ems_mem_used_mb
metrics.description: Used physical memory of a MetaView EMS node in megabytes (METASWITCH-MIB emsStatsPhysMemUsage).

metrics.name: metaswitch_ems_mem_usage_percent
metrics.description: Physical memory usage percent of a MetaView EMS node, derived as used megabytes times 100 divided by total megabytes when total is greater than zero and used is within total.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
